FOLDEE Atelier Frameset
The original FOLDEE. Handmade in Melbourne from premium chromoly tubing in small production runs. Built for riders who appreciate craftsmanship, durability and a cargo bike frame that will last a lifetime.
This is where FOLDEE began.
Each Premium Steel Frameset is built by hand in Australia using high-quality chromoly tubing and traditional framebuilding techniques. Produced in small batches, these frames prioritise craftsmanship, durability and attention to detail.
Steel remains one of the best materials for cargo bikes thanks to its strength, fatigue resistance and forgiving ride quality. It allows us to build a frame that can handle serious loads while still feeling lively and comfortable to ride.
Every frame reflects the original FOLDEE philosophy: a capable cargo bike that can fold down and fit into real life. Strong enough for daily hauling, compact enough for apartments, cars and travel.
These limited production runs are built slowly and carefully - which means they often sell out quickly.
Technical highlights
• Handmade in Australia from premium chromoly steel tubing • Small batch production with careful frame finishing • Excellent durability and fatigue resistance for cargo use • Designed for daily riding, heavy loads and long-term reliability
Available colours
over 4,750 colours to choose from Dulux range* Complete bikes are to give an idea visually of how the bike could look. This product is a frame not a complete bike.
